title: Credential exposure — plaintext SecureString, reversible -Key, $Env: leaks
objective: Audit a shipped PowerShell script for credential-handling flaws: a SecureString built from in-script plaintext or an in-script symmetric -Key (neither is actually secret), and an $Env:-held secret that leaks into transcripts/4104 when echoed. Name the fix and the ATT&CK ID.
